original_card.question: Can the 64-per-call centre path (eight rank-8 COPY/ERASE totals through the private temporary) be shared across calls or shrunk?
methods: Prove a lower bound on copied information per call for the selected decoder contract.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show the changed centre charge and copy profile per call with every added restoration or hosting cost charged, and its ceiling via ceiling.ceiling(centre=...).

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the per-call centre charge and copy children for sharing across k = 2 calls, charge the sharing overhead, and screen it; stop this route if even the ideal sharing gains under 10%. Ideal budgets: free 2.80x, shared by two 1.90x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The centre path consumes 64 of about 99.6 unpaid coordinates per call, i.e. about 64% of the raw deficit.
allowed_variations: One sharing pattern across a fixed number of calls.
One reduced copied-total contract for the existing decoder.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Removing copies without a replacement contract for the decoder's copied totals.

actual_scope: Track 4A donor assignment: design the cheapest concrete two-call centre-sharing contracts (persistent 8-slot bank CB-A, deferred joint scatter CB-B, fused rank-16 descent CB-C under hypothesis (W)) on the selected #1094 word and 144-call schedule, price storage/reads/frame changes in full, derive exact break-even overhead with the pinned ceiling engine against the 32/call ideal and the unreviewed #2374 target, then test attainability by an all-pairs (10296) owner/chart census plus exact F_p scalar value-inequality witnesses. No packing/hosting/owner/dispatch/borrowing variation.
scope_change_reason: The card's first experiment (k=2 sharing, charged overhead, ceiling screen) is executed literally; refinement names the three concrete contracts and the changed hypotheses against #2052/#2076/#2048/#2203/#2118 and the descent/p111 floors (README table) instead of reopening their excluded domains. The card's under-10% whole-bound stop is retained as context (bit-fixed cap +3.4536%); the donor target is beating #2374, which lies below that cap.
bottleneck_link: Centre charge 64/call is about 64% of the raw deficit; ideal two-call sharing is the 1.90x complex lever. This package decides whether any fully charged two-call contract on the selected word retains a real eliminated cost.
stop_rule: Cheapest falsification first: exact ceilings/break-even, then census/witnesses. Build on the selected word only if a pair survives with net saving above the break-even threshold (>=4 rank-8 children over the schedule, relaxation). Otherwise record the sharp falsification and handoff; do not widen to changed schedules, T74 words, or unpaid>=2 in this package.
